The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Plate 09131 of the Russian Lives of the Saints (1903-1911), whose numbering puts it on 13 May - the folder's feast day. Captioned Glikeriya and Laodiky and filed under Category:Saint Glyceria; Laodicius was the jailer converted at her martyrdom and is commemorated with her, so the joint plate is this folder's saint. The second plate of the day, 09132, is an Alexander. Commons describes it: Иллюстрации к книге: Жития святых на русском языке, изложенные по руководству Четьих-Миней  с дополнениями, объяснительными примечаниями и изображениями святых
